answer: A payout is split so that 27% arrives at settlement and the rest over 20 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The ivory schedule is applied in beacon and whisper shows each instalment. Anyone hence cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1497 identities would post 1084 proofs and burn roughly 60 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
